name: Helinox (founding family, South Korea)
note: South Korean outdoor-furniture company. The Hyundai Motorsport partners page (hyundai.com) describes Helinox as 'maker-founded and family-owned since 2008'; Genesis Magma Racing's announcement calls it a South Korean brand. The founding family is not named on either page and no open ownership register was found (Korean corporate registry not openly accessible online). parentId null.
